stem: Ari wants to close his paper with a call to action. Which of these sentences could be added after sentence 21 to accomplish this goal?

options.label: A
options.text: In closing, students will be proud of what they've done to improve their school and community.

options.label: B
options.text: A citizenship program is a valuable idea for helping people get things done that might not otherwise be done.

options.label: C
options.text: Let's give students at our school an opportunity to experience that pride by beginning a citizenship program here.

options.label: D
options.text: Clearly, the extra work is worth the effort for everyone who is involved in creating a citizenship program today.
